flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signup then Type "Receipt Tester" into the Full name field
Type "receiptowslo8@mlyfo.app" into the Email field
Type "receiptowslo8" into the Username field
Type "kane-password-123" into the Password field
Click "Create account"

Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/pad then Type "pay @kabir 10 for lunch" into the Message field
Click the "Pay $10.00" button
Assert the keyboard card says "Sent $10.00 to @kabir" and shows a receipt ID starting with "MLY-"
Assert the keyboard card says the money was delivered to @kabir

Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app then Click the "Receipt" link in Recent activity
Assert the receipt page shows $10.00 paid to @kabir with a receipt ID starting with "MLY-"
